apple-spotlight.description: A macOS-style spotlight search component with animated shortcuts and search results. Features a beautiful blur effect, animated shortcut buttons, and live search results.

arrow-fill-button.description: A rounded button with an expanding color fill and a sliding arrow on hover or keyboard focus.

art-gallery.description: A lensed photo grid you can drag through, with barrel distortion and infinite tiled studies.

book-flip.description: A tactile 3D book with bending pages, realistic light, and interactive page turns.

butterfly-trail-cursor.description: Animated butterflies lift away from the pointer with soft wing motion and fading trails.

circle-menu.description: A radial navigation menu that expands in a circular pattern with smooth spring animations and hover effects.

colorful-cursor-aura.description: Three colored masks follow the pointer through bold typography with staggered easing.

curved-plane.description: An image carousel whose edges curve and stretch with your drag and scroll velocity.

dither-canvas.description: A video becomes a bright blue and cyan dither texture on white, with fluid distortion that follows your pointer.

dotted-grid.description: An animated dot field transforms between geometric shapes and responds to your cursor with a glowing trail.

draggable-marquee.description: A continuous image marquee with drag momentum and a seamless looping track.

flip-scroll.description: A scroll-triggered flip animation where elements rotate and transform as you scroll. Creates a dynamic, engaging scroll experience.

flip-text.description: An animated text component where each character flips and rotates on hover. Creates a playful, interactive typography effect.

flow-scroll.description: A smooth scroll-driven animation where elements flow and transform as you scroll through the page. Creates a cinematic experience.

folder-preview.description: An interactive 3D folder that opens to reveal image contents.

fractal-glass.description: Glass strips refract an image with fractal distortion and pointer-driven parallax.

glowing-scroll-indicator.description: An animated scroll progress indicator with glowing bars that light up as you scroll.

grid-lift.description: A fine grid lifts into a dimensional text or SVG mask around your pointer.

horizontal-scroll.description: A smooth horizontal scrolling section that transforms vertical scroll into horizontal movement. Perfect for portfolios, galleries, and feature showcases.

hover-img.description: A stunning hover-based image preview component. When users hover over project titles, a smooth mouse-following thumbnail appears showcasing the corresponding image. Perfect for portfolios, project showcases, and creative agency websites.

interactive-arrows.description: Six canvas arrow and line patterns respond to the pointer with rotation, spacing, and opacity.

interactive-blur-reveal.description: A frosted image becomes clear beneath a fluid cursor trail, with noise distortion and subtle grain.

interactive-hover-slider.description: An editorial list reveals a curved image stack with elastic image transitions.

jelly-loader.description: A beautiful loading animation with stacked, rotating elliptical shapes that create a mesmerizing jelly-like effect. Uses a gradient color palette from light pink to deep magenta.

magnet-tabs.description: Animated tab navigation with magnetic hover effect and smooth indicator transitions.

magnetic-image-trail.description: A cluster of images follows your cursor with magnetic momentum and a diagonal orbit.

mask-cursor-effect.description: A cursor-following mask effect that reveals hidden content on hover. Creates an engaging reveal experience.

masonry-grid.description: A responsive masonry-style image grid with hover animations and lightbox support.

otp-input.description: An animated 6-digit OTP verification input with success/error states and smooth animations.

parallax-gallery.description: A framed gallery with rotating photographs, moving side thumbnails, and scroll snapping.

pixelated-carousel.description: An image carousel with a unique pixelated transition effect. Images dissolve into pixels and reassemble for the next slide.

rectangular-text-reveal.description: Colored rectangles sweep across each line before revealing the text underneath.

rope-cursor.description: A smooth segmented rope follows the pointer with progressively delayed motion.

scroll-effect.description: A stacking card scroll effect where cards stack on top of each other as you scroll.

scroll-stack.description: Successive cards scale into focus and fade as the next section takes their place.

svg-path-marquee.description: Images follow a looping SVG curve with drag momentum and scroll-responsive speed.

svg-pixel-reveal.description: An SVG pixel filter dissolves into a crisp photograph as it enters the scroll area.

text-fill-animation.description: A scroll-driven color sweep brings text into focus one character at a time.

text-stream.description: A continuous vertical text stream changes speed and direction with your scroll.

trading-card.description: A 3D interactive trading card with perspective transforms that respond to mouse movement. Features smooth reveal animations and a premium holographic feel.
